title: Pawan Hans Partners with Norway's Noemi Aerospace for Electric Seaplanes
summary: Promotes green aviation and regional seaplane connectivity under UDAN framework.

blocks.content: Promotes green aviation and regional seaplane connectivity under UDAN framework.

items: State-owned helicopter operator Pawan Hans signed MoU with Norway's Noemi Aerospace to deploy electric seaplanes.
Aims to enhance regional coastal connectivity under UDAN scheme.
